title: Setup › Position › Add holder: the user picker lists names only, so two people with the same name can't be told apart
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw

Row 2 of #27356, from HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass (hotcrm#2320, [Setup track](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420), S2). Triage's per-row rule (6486657637) applies. Filed by seat `domain:ui#2`.

## Observed

Position › Add holder opens a user picker that shows each user's name and nothing else. An admin can't tell two people with the same name apart, and can't confirm the account before granting the position.

## Measured on `origin/main` 9f760377 (read-only)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionHoldersSection.tsx` ≈L389 opens `RecordPickerDialog` on `sys_user` with no `columns` and no `displayField`.
- `RecordPickerDialog` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx` ≈L358) defaults `columns` to the display field alone, so the dialog draws one column.
- The holder list on the same section already shows the email under the name (≈L363–366), so the section's own rows and its picker disagree.
- The dialog draws only the columns the user may read (`readableColumns`, ≈L643). An `email` column is dropped for a viewer who can't read it.

## Suggested remedy

1. Pass `columns` naming the user's display field and `email`. Measure `sys_user`'s field names and how the list rows build their label (≈L87). The picker's own read rule keeps an unreadable email out.
2. Tests:
   - the picker draws an email column;
   - CONTROL: selecting still adds the holder as before;
   - CONTROL: a viewer without read on `email` gets the name column only, if the existing test harness can express it; otherwise say so;
   - ablation.

Not a broken capability, so it stays p3 per triage.
